title: Attention-Based Factor Stat Arb on Large-Cap Universe
source: arXiv:2510.11616 — Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage
summary: Attention-based factor learning for cross-sectional stat arb achieves Sharpe 2.3 with realistic transaction costs (84% improvement over prior deep learning stat arb methods at daily frequency). Replaces cointegration-based pairs with learned attention factors across the full universe.

design.features: Daily OHLCV + technical indicators (RSI, MACD, ATR via TA-Lib)
design.model: Attention-based factor extractor (self-attention on stock cross-section)
design.signal: Z-score on attention factor exposures; threshold |z| > 1.5 for entry

success_criterion: OOS Sharpe >= 1.5, MaxDD <= -20%, IC > 0.05 on factor exposures
effort: MEDIUM — 2-3 days to implement attention factor model + backtest
notes: Pairs family (H152-H160) was exhausted at daily frequency using standard cointegration. Attention factors are a fundamentally different approach — cross-sectional learning rather than pairwise cointegration. Worth testing.
